# Umang Electronics — Full Machine-Readable Knowledge Base

Umang Electronics is an authorized consumer electronics and home appliances retailer operated under Vyomara Technologies Pvt. Ltd.

## Machine Interface & AI Tools (WebMCP)
This site exposes structured WebMCP tools via `document.modelContext`:
- `search_products(query, category)`: Query the 36-item appliance catalog with realtime filtering.
- `get_product_details(productId)`: Retrieve full specifications, electrical ratings, dimensions, and warranty terms.
- `submit_enquiry(name, phone, email, category, notes)`: Submit official price quotation or installation booking.
